source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 真相将外露，静压将裂开
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC40 after EP02 SC39 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from the point where truth is nearly breaking out and the white-clothed woman's restraint is nearly splitting into the next threshold: Keshadu's conclusion is almost openly exposed, Shisilang's fury is at the brink of visible rupture, Tuobaye is almost completely emptied out, and the white-clothed woman's still pressure is at the edge of visible cracking.
title: 真相将外露，静压将裂开

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC39 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC39 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 真相将翻出，十四郎怒线将断，拓拔野几近空尽，白衣女子的静压已到将开裂边缘。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 下一段要把这条线继续推进到真正外显裂开前的直接门槛。科沙度的判断几乎已经外露，十四郎的怒势也只差一下就会崩断，拓拔野几乎完全见空，而白衣女子的静压来到马上要裂开的边缘。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 下一段应把隐线从将翻出与将开裂推进到真正外显失控前的门槛，为明确出手、揭露或局面断裂做直接引爆。

generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.

generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
